claim: When the beeper routines run only from the interrupt handler, run game logic at 28 MHz and drop to 3.5 MHz for the original handler, which keeps pitch and timing; first check which routines the handler calls.

evidence.text: 28 MHz from the level draw to the next Layer 2 off; title, scores, name entry and continue run at 3.5 MHz (busy-loop timing); the native ISR (all beeper sound) always runs at 3.5 MHz.
evidence.quote: continue run at 3.5MHz: busy-loop timing); the native ISR (all beeper sound) always 3.5MHz.
